sessions.phase_label: Deliverable scoping and iOS screenshot production kickoff
Screenshot review, feature graphic revisions, and final delivery

requirements.title: Eight iPhone Screenshots
requirements.definition: Provide a complete set of eight marketing screenshots for iOS phones, excluding iPad assets.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers set-level quantity and device scope only; independently reviewed visual requirements for screenshots 1, 2, and 6 remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Screenshot 1 Facial Presentation
requirements.definition: Present suitable facial expressions in the first iOS screenshot rather than upset or sad expressions.
requirements.boundary_note: Separated because screenshot 1 received its own visual correction and can be revised or accepted independently of the other screenshots.

requirements.title: Screenshot 2 Content-Protection Presentation
requirements.definition: Compose the second AI-skipping/content-protection screenshot using the approved source image, category pills, and restrained kissing imagery.
requirements.boundary_note: Category-pill selection, source-image choice, and kissing imagery are treated as attributes of one screenshot composition. The filename in message 13 suggests screenshot 2, but attachment metadata is unavailable.

requirements.title: Screenshot 6 Google TV Messaging
requirements.definition: Make the sixth iOS screenshot communicate that the app can be watched on any Google TV device.
requirements.boundary_note: Separated because screenshot 6 has its own communication objective and can be revised or accepted independently of the other screenshots.

requirements.title: Play Store Feature Graphic
requirements.definition: Provide the Android Play Store feature graphic with the approved dimensions, logo treatment, tagline, supporting copy, and alignment.
requirements.boundary_note: The tagline, bottom copy, logo alignment, and dimensions are composition attributes of one independently delivered feature graphic rather than separate Requirements.

unresolved_candidates.description: The unavailable attachments prevent definitive confirmation that the requested 02-ai-skipping.png replacement belongs to screenshot 2 rather than another screenshot asset.
An editable Figma file was delivered and followed by broad client approval, but visible history does not show an unambiguous client request establishing it as an independent deliverable Requirement.
